public_rationale: The May 16, 2023 transcript records Altman saying, “I have no equity in OpenAI” [e1]. This supplies context but cannot settle the claim’s tentative assessment that he “appears to have misled” people [e1]. Verifying the quoted statement alone does not make that assessment adjudicable [e1].
limitations: The transcript does not establish Altman’s direct or indirect holdings, Startup Fund interests, or personal economic interests.
It does not establish the alleged disclosure omissions or whether listeners were misled.
The underlying holdings and disclosure assertions would require separate assessment; doing so would not settle the hedged claim as worded.

Treating 'appears' as merely removing a requirement to prove intent would turn the hedged assessment into a firm claim the speaker did not make.
The underlying holdings and disclosure assertions could be assessed separately, but doing so would not settle this claim as worded.
criteria.support_condition: No binary support condition preserves the tentative meaning of 'appears to have misled'. Records could establish the underlying statements and holdings, but scoring those alone would substitute a narrower claim.
criteria.contradiction_condition: No binary contradiction condition preserves the claim as worded. Contrary records could undermine its factual premises without supplying an objective test of the hedged assessment.
